data.gender_notes: Alena is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'alēn', meaning 'other', 'another', 'different'. In Greek mythology, Alena was a variant of Selene, the goddess of the moon. The name evokes a sense of otherworldliness and mystique. The name Alena carries the meaning “Moon goddess” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Alena usually hope their child will grow to embody moon goddess and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Alena belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Moon goddess.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Alena total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.
